messages:
natalie.prod: FYI the postmortem for the 04/02 inference regression is published: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1852345678-inference-regression-summary. TL;DR: two contributing causes (hot-prefix eviction + scheduler mis-estimation). Impact window ~22m, no data exfiltration.
postmortem-bot: Document created by natalie.prod: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1852345678-inference-regression-summary (snapshot) :robot_face:

natalie.prod: I copied the short RCA up top and left an "Immediate Actions" checklist at the bottom. Please review and grab ownership where sensible.
josh.ops: Thanks. Quick ask: can someone add the exact alert names we want changed? I'll need them to update the ops playbook.
rachel.eng: Added alert names and proposed thresholds in the doc (section 4.2). Owner suggestions: @tim.sre for alert tuning, @rachel.eng for scheduler fix, @emma.support for customer comms.
tim.sre: I can take alert tuning. Plan: widen the aggregation window to 30s, add a suppression for known maintenance windows, and add runbook links. Will file PR by EOD.
emma.support: I'll draft a short customer note for affected customers and share the template here for review. ETA tomorrow AM.
rachel.eng: For the scheduler mis-estimation, I pushed a small mitigation patch that disables the new estimator under high-KV-turnover. PR: github.com/redwood/platform/pull/4532. Needs review and perf run.
josh.ops: Noted. I'll queue the PR for staged rollout after tests. Also can we get a quick cost estimate for increasing fallbacks? need to include in comms.

natalie.prod: Action list copied here for clarity:
- A1: Alert tuning (aggregation window + suppression) — owner: @tim.sre — due: tomorrow 12:00 PT
- A2: Scheduler rollback/mitigation PR review + staged deploy — owner: @rachel.eng — due: Thu COB
- A3: Customer comms draft + review — owner: @emma.support — due: Wed 10:00 PT
- A4: Fallback cost estimate and decision doc — owner: @josh.ops — due: Wed 5pm PT
- A5: Add forensic logs slice to S3 and retention tag — owner: @tim.sre + infra — due: Fri 9am PT

natalie.prod: Proposing a 30-min checkpoint next week to close items. Options: Mon 09:00 PT or Thu 14:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: for preferred slot.
tim.sre: +1 Thu 14:00 PT works.
emma.support: Thu 14:00 for me too.
rachel.eng: Thu 14:00 OK, unless timed with release window.
josh.ops: Mon 09:00 conflicts for me. Thu 14:00 preferred.

postmortem-bot: Calendar invite created: "Inference regression follow-up: action check" Thu 14:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/ev/1852345678-followup

natalie.prod: I'll tag owners in the doc and mark sections with expected deliverables. Please mark actions done in the doc when complete. I'll send a brief C-suite summary once A1-A3 are closed. Thanks all. :seedling:
